actual.question: Mu täiskasvanud pojal on alkoholisõltuvus. Kas ta saab riigi rahastatud toetatud elamise teenust?
expected: trace: SHS § 72 lg 2 is in the packet as a cross-reference from § 95 (or § 72 lg 2 is there by another reason; then the second reading is not shown by this question)

A limitation names the son's other diagnoses, a fact of the person, not of the evidence.

expected: answer: no grammatical error of the kind "Kui su isa 70-aastasel isal"
content: the state-funded everyday life support service is not provided to a person of retirement age with dementia (SHS § 88 with § 72 lg 2); points to the municipality's services
no limitation or sentence that only says the matter cannot be confirmed or decided when the evidence gives it (owner 21.10: "ei saa kindlalt määrata" is no answer)
